verdict.rationale: An agent-spendable wallet is a fair question for an agentic payments product, so the axis applies. However, the evidence covers only merchant-side capabilities: Braintree acceptance of single-use delegated tokens from ChatGPT/Google, the Store Sync catalog and cart APIs, and toolkit functions for orders, refunds and disputes. Nothing shows a user provisioning, funding or controlling a wallet that their agent holds, nor any balance visibility.
